Create a unique brand identity, original layouts, and a polished user experience while maintaining a similar professional, modern style.### Design Direction- Premium, modern, minimalist design.- Clean typography with large, bold headlines.- Generous whitespace and clear visual hierarchy.- White and light-gray backgrounds with black text and a distinctive accent color.- Smooth scrolling, subtle animations, polished hover effects, and refined transitions.- Professional project mockups, interface previews, and visual elements.- Fully responsive on desktop, tablet, and mobile.- Avoid generic AI-generated website layouts and excessive gradients.### Website Structure**1. Header**Include the company logo, Services, Our Work, Pricing, About, Resources, and a prominent Contact Us button. Make the navigation responsive and functional.**2. Hero Section**Create a bold headline explaining how the agency helps businesses grow through digital products and technology.Add a short supporting paragraph, a primary “Start a Project” button, and a secondary “View Our Work” button. Use an attractive product interface mockup or carefully designed visual on the right.**3. Trust Section**Create a clean area for client logos and credibility indicators. Do not invent real clients or misleading statistics. Use clearly identified placeholders until real information is available.**4. Selected Projects**Display projects in premium cards with screenshots or interface mockups, project names, short descriptions, services provided, and case-study links. Make the cards visually engaging.**5. Services**Include:- Web Development- UI/UX Design- Brand Identity- Landing Page Design- E-commerce Development- Business Automation- AI Integration- Mobile App Development- Website MaintenanceEach service should have a title, concise description, visual icon, and working link or action.**6. Results and Benefits**Explain how the agency helps clients launch products, improve user experience, simplify operations, and grow their businesses. Do not fabricate performance statistics.**7. Why Choose Us**Show the agency's strengths, development process, communication standards, and support options.**8. Pricing**Create an elegant pricing section with editable service packages. Use “Request a Quote” when actual pricing is unavailable. Do not invent guarantees or commercial promises.**9. Contact Section**Create a compelling call to action and a working project inquiry form with name, email, company, service type, budget range, and project description fields. Include validation, loading states, success feedback, and error handling.**10. FAQ and Footer**Add an interactive FAQ accordion, company information, navigation links, social links, contact details, and privacy and terms links.### Technical Requirements1. Inspect the existing project and its framework before making changes.2. Reuse the existing stack when practical. For a new project, use Next.js, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS.3. Build reusable components and maintain a clean project structure.4. Implement real navigation and functional interactive elements.5. Add appropriate responsive layouts, accessibility features, and SEO metadata.6. Optimize images and performance.7. Do not create fake backend integrations. Clearly identify any required API credentials or backend setup.8. Use English for all visible website content, including navigation, headings, buttons, forms, messages, and footer text.9. Do not stop after creating a static mockup. Implement the website, run the available checks, fix errors, and verify that the main interactions work.Start by inspecting the project, then build the complete website. **Design**
- **Look:** white and light-gray backgrounds with black text and a signal-orange accent (`#ff4a1c`).
- **Type:** Space Grotesk headlines, Inter body text.
- **Mockups:** all interface mockups are built in code, so there are no image files to load.
- **Motion:** scroll-reveal animations and hover effects, switched off for users who prefer reduced motion.

**Content, all in English and in your 10-section order**
- **Header:** sticky, with a working mobile menu and a Contact Us button.
- **Hero:** headline, supporting paragraph, Start a Project and View Our Work buttons, and a dashboard mockup on the right.
- **Trust:** logo and statistic placeholders that are clearly labelled, with no invented clients or numbers.
- **Selected projects:** four cards marked "Concept". Their case-study links lead to the contact form, because no real case studies exist yet.
- **Services:** all nine, each with an icon and an Enquire action that pre-selects that service in the form.
- **Results and benefits, Why choose us, Pricing, FAQ:** built as specified. Pricing shows "Request a Quote" on every package.
- **Contact:** the form has the six fields you listed, plus validation, a loading state, a success message and error messages.
- **Footer:** company info, navigation, social links, contact details, and privacy and terms links.

**Other additions**
- **Spam protection:** the form has a hidden honeypot field.
- **Search and SEO:** metadata, Open Graph tags, `robots.txt`, a sitemap, structured data and a favicon.
- **Accessibility:** a skip link and focus styles.

**To fill in before launch**
- Edit `src/content/site.ts` for your contact details, social links, services, packages, prices and FAQs. The email, phone and address in it are placeholders.
- The Privacy and Terms pages are template placeholders and need real text reviewed by a legal professional.
